column1: # What each menu entry does, in words someone new to Omarchy would use.
# One line per entry: the path (no icon), a tab, then the description.
# Everyday words belong in here too, since the launcher matches the whole line:
# typing "sound", "internet" or "print screen" should find the right row.
# Entries with no line here fall back to Omarchy's own summary for the command
# they run, or to a description built from the path.
